  "titleAr":"تصريف الأفعال وأسماء الإشارة",

  "objectiveAr":"التمييز بين ce و cet و cette و ces، وإتقان تصريف أفعال prendre و aller و voyager في المضارع واستخدامها في سياق السفر.",
  "vocabulary":[{"word":"ce","translation":"هذا (مذكر)","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/lesson3-demonstratives.svg","example":"Ce train est rapide.","pronunciation":"ce تُنطق /sə/."},{"word":"cet","translation":"هذا (مذكر قبل متحرك أو h صامت)","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/lesson3-demonstratives.svg","example":"Cet avion est grand.","pronunciation":"cet تُنطق تقريبًا /sɛ/."},{"word":"cette","translation":"هذه","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/lesson3-demonstratives.svg","example":"Cette valise est lourde.","pronunciation":"cette تُنطق /sɛt/."},{"word":"ces","translation":"هؤلاء / هذه (جمع)","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/lesson3-demonstratives.svg","example":"Ces billets sont importants.","pronunciation":"ces تُنطق /se/."},{"word":"rapide","translation":"سريع","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/lesson3-demonstratives.svg","example":"Le train est rapide.","pronunciation":"r فرنسية حلقية؛ e الأخيرة لا تُنطق عادةً."},{"word":"lent","translation":"بطيء","image":"assets/vocabulary/unit3/lesson3-demonstratives.svg","example":"Le bus est lent.","pronunciation":"lent تُنطق تقريبًا /lɑ̃/؛ ent النهائية لا تُنطق."}],
  "grammar":{"title":"Les adjectifs démonstratifs + prendre, aller, voyager","explanationAr":"نستخدم ce مع المذكر المفرد الذي يبدأ بصوت ساكن، cet مع المذكر المفرد الذي يبدأ بمتحرك أو h صامت، cette مع المؤنث المفرد، وces مع الجمع. ثم نراجع تصريف أفعال الحركة والسفر الأساسية في المضارع.","steps":["مذكر مفرد + ساكن → ce: ce train.","مذكر مفرد + متحرك أو h صامت → cet: cet avion, cet hôtel.","مؤنث مفرد → cette: cette valise.","جمع مذكر أو مؤنث → ces: ces billets, ces valises.","C'est = ce + est، وCe sont = ce + sont.","PRENDRE: je prends, tu prends, il/elle prend, nous prenons, vous prenez, ils/elles prennent.","ALLER: je vais, tu vas, il/elle va, nous allons, vous allez, ils/elles vont.","VOYAGER: je voyage, tu voyages, il/elle voyage, nous voyageons, vous voyagez, ils/elles voyagent.","لاحظ: مع nous في voyager نكتب voyageons للحفاظ على صوت /ʒ/."],"tables":[{"verb":"prendre","forms":["je prends","tu prends","il/elle prend","nous prenons","vous prenez","ils/elles prennent"]},{"verb":"aller","forms":["je vais","tu vas","il/elle va","nous allons","vous allez","ils/elles vont"]},{"verb":"voyager","forms":["je voyage","tu voyages","il/elle voyage","nous voyageons","vous voyagez","ils/elles voyagent"]}],"examples":[{"fr":"Ce train est rapide.","ar":"هذا القطار سريع."},{"fr":"Cet avion est grand.","ar":"هذه الطائرة كبيرة."},{"fr":"Cette valise est lourde.","ar":"هذه الحقيبة ثقيلة."},{"fr":"Ces billets sont importants.","ar":"هذه التذاكر مهمة."},{"fr":"Je prends ce train.","ar":"أستقل هذا القطار."},{"fr":"Nous allons à la gare.","ar":"نذهب إلى المحطة."},{"fr":"Ils voyagent en France.","ar":"هم يسافرون في فرنسا."}],"ruleBox":["ce = مذكر مفرد + ساكن","cet = مذكر مفرد + متحرك أو h صامت","cette = مؤنث مفرد","ces = جمع","prendre: prends / prends / prend / prenons / prenez / prennent","aller: vais / vas / va / allons / allez / vont","voyager: voyage / voyages / voyage / voyageons / voyagez / voyagent"]},
  "conversation":{"lines":[{"speaker":"Sara","fr":"Quel train prends-tu ?","ar":"أي قطار ستستقل؟"},{"speaker":"Adam","fr":"Je prends ce train-ci.","ar":"سأستقل هذا القطار."},{"speaker":"Sara","fr":"Tu vas où ?","ar":"إلى أين تذهب؟"},{"speaker":"Adam","fr":"Je vais à Paris et je voyage en train.","ar":"أذهب إلى باريس وأسافر بالقطار."},{"speaker":"Sara","fr":"Et cette valise ?","ar":"وماذا عن هذه الحقيبة؟"},{"speaker":"Adam","fr":"C'est ma valise.","ar":"هذه حقيبتي."},{"speaker":"Sara","fr":"Et ces billets ?","ar":"وهذه التذاكر؟"},{"speaker":"Adam","fr":"Ce sont nos billets.","ar":"هذه تذاكرنا."}]},
  "practice":[{"question":"اختر: ___ train","options":["ce","cette","ces"],"answer":0},{"question":"اختر: ___ avion","options":["cet","ce","cette"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Nous ___ le train.","options":["prenons","prenez","prennent"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Vous ___ à Paris.","options":["allez","allons","vont"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Ils ___ en France.","options":["voyagent","voyagez","voyageons"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Je ___ ce billet.","options":["prends","prend","prenons"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Nous ___ en été.","options":["voyageons","voyagez","voyagent"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Ils ___ leurs billets.","options":["prennent","prenons","prenez"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Je ___ à la gare.","options":["vais","vas","vont"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Elle ___ en France.","options":["voyage","voyages","voyagent"],"answer":0}],
  "assessment":{"questions":[{"question":"أي صيغة صحيحة مع train؟","options":["ce train","cette train","ces train","cet train"],"answer":0},{"question":"أي صيغة صحيحة مع avion؟","options":["cet avion","ce avion","cette avion","ces avion"],"answer":0},{"question":"أي صيغة صحيحة مع valise؟","options":["cette valise","ce valise","cet valise","ces valise"],"answer":0},{"question":"أي صيغة صحيحة مع billets؟","options":["ces billets","ce billets","cette billets","cet billets"],"answer":0},{"question":"اختر تصريف prendre مع nous.","options":["prenons","prenez","prennent","prend"],"answer":0},{"question":"اختر تصريف aller مع vous.","options":["allez","allons","vont","vais"],"answer":0},{"question":"اختر تصريف voyager مع ils.","options":["voyagent","voyageons","voyagez","voyage"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Je ___ à Paris.","options":["vais","vas","va","allons"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Nous ___ en France.","options":["voyageons","voyagez","voyagent","voyage"],"answer":0},{"question":"أكمل: Ils ___ le train.","options":["prennent","prenons","prenez","prend"],"answer":0},{"question":"لماذا نستخدم cet مع hôtel؟","options":["مذكر مفرد ويبدأ بـ h صامت","مؤنث مفرد","جمع","لأنه فعل"],"answer":0},{"question":"أي جملة صحيحة؟","options":["Nous allons à la gare.","Nous allez à la gare.","Nous vont à la gare.","Nous vais à la gare."],"answer":0}],
